rules.rule: For every added or modified .patch file, verify that the embedded commit-message body is self-contained and accurately explains the problem, the behavior before the change, what the patch changes, and the user-visible, kernel, or hardware impact. Flag generic summaries that merely repeat the subject.

When the functional diff payload inside an existing .patch file changes, require the embedded commit-message body to describe every newly introduced behavior or fix. Treat an unchanged description accompanying a functional payload change as a high-severity defect.
Patch descriptions must be understandable to an external community reviewer. Internal Jira, NVBug, or other private references may supplement the explanation but must never be its sole justification.

Every patch must have attributable git-format-patch provenance: commit From line, author From header, Date, meaningful Subject, Signed-off-by, and Upstream-Status. Do not accept invented or packaging-only authorship unless the patch author explicitly owns the change.
